newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore investors wary ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Singapore investors wary ahead of results.

text.p: Nervousness over the outcome of corporate results, especially of blue chip Fraser & Neave, kept investors sidelined on Friday morning, dealers said.
"People are wary especially after heavyweight, blue chip Cerebos gave such an unpleasant surprise during its interim results," said one fund manager.
Instead of expected double digit growth, the food-related company posted flat earnings for the six months ended March 31, 1997, and warned of a tougher second-half.
Soft drink company F&N results were due later Friday.
Its shares were flat at S$10.40 on 521,000 shares traded.
After a brief boost to 1,995.82 from Wall Street's record close on Thursday, the Straits Times Industrials Index eased to 1,989.23 at midday, down 1.45 points.

HongKong Land ended the session up US$0.05 at US$2.61 on 3.6 million shares. Electronic-based Uraco Holdings was active with 26.4 million shares as concerns subsided over its link with CAM International Holdings, under investigation by Singapore's Commercial Affairs Department. Uraco has a 6.48 stake in it. Some dealers said Uraco's activity could be on rumours it was writing off its investment in CAM. Company officals were not available for comment. --Angela Tan (65 8703083)
